Pinned revision: 9d8f6ea04c83cccccb3dd7851a631bbd53a8dbbe
Referenced CriHcaDecoder.cs, CriHcaPacking.cs, CriHcaFrame.cs,
CriHcaKey.cs, HcaInfo.cs, and Utilities/Mdct.cs.
The JavaScript DCT-IV/overlap structure and cipher construction are adapted
from these sources. No CLR executable, assembly, or generated compiled
JavaScript is shipped or used by the browser implementation.

vgmstream official HCA decoder, permissive license reproduced below
https://github.com/vgmstream/vgmstream
Pinned revision: d9875b1fff307e4759dfb85e49e3d5e6fb196f7c (r2168)
Referenced src/coding/libs/clhca.c, clhca_data.h, src/meta/hca.c,
src/meta/hca_keys.h, and src/coding/hca_decoder.c.
Numerical ATH, dequantizer, resolution, codebook, scaling, intensity, and
window tables in dist/hca-tables.js are transcribed from clhca_data.h.
The public known-key list is transcribed from hca_keys.h (223 entries).
Version-3 unpacking, noise/high-frequency reconstruction and key/subkey
handling are adapted from the official reference. The clHCA source credits
Nyagamon (original HCA decompilation), kode54 (C port), bnnm (v3 work),
Thealexbarney (VGAudio), and Youjose (ambisonics information).
